players.product: InP MOCVD epiwafers for laser companies (EML and CW laser production)

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 2026 EPS was NT$1.06. Microelectronics (RF PA epitaxy, roughly ninety percent on 6-inch, world number one in PA epi foundry since 2021) did well - Q1 came in even above last year's Q4 - helped by customers moving to Wi-Fi 7 (including drone and robot applications), with several customers already developing Wi-Fi 8; a price increase on microelectronics took effect in Q2 to pass through substrate cost hikes. VPEC stresses it is a pure-play epitaxial foundry - no strategic alliances, cross-holdings or back-end processing - which it credits for its optical-communications customer count multiplying, including optical-module makers and Taiwan IPO-bound companies, some even bringing their own substrates.

MOCVD fleet expanding on data-center optics demand: 62 reactors today, with 5 more purchased this year all arriving by Q3 for a total of 67. The new tool purchases are driven by very strong data-center demand forecasts, with shipments expected to be very high both this year and next.
quarterly_data.figure: 62 MOCVD reactors now, rising to 67 by Q3 2026 as this year's newly purchased tools arrive

quarterly_data.signal: Data-center optics ramp: on the receiver side both 100G and 200G products are in mass production and shipping, with 100G (i.e. 800G transceivers) the mainstay this year and 1.6T expected to be a breakout next year. On the transmit side, 400G lasers entered mass production in Q2 2026 (first design win back in March 2023), with volumes expected to multiply next year, and CW laser customers have been in mass production since Q4 2024. New applications: solar-cell substrates for drones and low-earth-orbit satellites (including radiation-resistant flexible solar panels, with an LEO satellite project this year), and VCSELs used as the heating source in HAMR HDDs - in development for two years, with a meaningful contribution expected next year and the year after.
quarterly_data.figure: receiver-side 100G and 200G in mass production; 800G the mainstay this year with a 1.6T breakout expected next year; transmit-side 400G in mass production from Q2; CW lasers in production since Q4 2024

quarterly_data.signal: China substrate export licence still pending: VPEC has not yet received the export permit for substrates affected by China's export controls, but two weeks ago it was notified to file supplementary documents (routine paperwork) and completed the filing last week - management likens the situation to finally seeing the light at the end of the tunnel.
